paper_title: Ultralight vector dark matter search using data from the KAGRA O3GK run
suggested_experiment_name: KAGRA O3GK auxiliary channel U(1)_{B-L} DM search
notes: Paper presents a 95% CL upper limit on the U(1)_{B-L} gauge coupling epsilon_{B-L} from KAGRA O3GK auxiliary-channel data (MICH and PRCL), in the mass range ~1e-14 to 1e-11 eV. The text estimates the limit is at best O(1e-20), weaker than previous bounds.
